title: On the $\uptheta$-vacua and CP violation
summary: Recent claims have suggested the absence of CP violation in theories with a $θ$-vacuum structure, particularly in quantum chromodynamics. We highlight several key points, from a perspective that is not widely discussed in the literature, which clarify why such conclusions are incorrect. In particular, an open boundary in a finite-volume theory must be accompanied by boundary degrees of freedom, the edge modes, in order to preserve large gauge invariance and faithfully capture the topological features of the theory.
